newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK leather firm seen in HK$100 mln IPO -- sources.
newsitem.headline: HK leather firm seen in HK$100 mln IPO -- sources.

text.p: Leather garments manufacturer and distributor Dragonfield Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 100 million shares at about HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said on Friday.
"The company is expected to raise about HK$100 million in IPO but not many listing details are available to the market yet," a corporate finance source said.
Dragonfield engages in trading and manufacturing of leather garments in Hong Kong and China. The company is expected to hold a presentation for analysts on Monday, sources said.

"Sale and manufacture of leather garment accounted for about 45 percent of its total sales for the year ended in March 1996, while 55 percent was from trading and distribution of leather garment," another source said.
